description: Header file for auto-fitter routines in FreeType, defining global hinting values, styles, scripts, classes, and functions related to font hinting and style management.

classes.name: AF_FaceGlobalsRec
classes.description: Structure representing global font hinting data for a face, including glyph styles, metrics, and font object.

methods.name: af_face_globals_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new AF_FaceGlobals object for a given font face.

methods.name: af_face_globals_get_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves style-specific metrics for a font face.

methods.name: af_face_globals_is_digit
methods.description: Checks if a glyph style corresponds to a digit.
